results.Name: נושאים נבחרים ביזמות עסקית 1
results.StudyContentDescription: The course introduces the worlds of entrepreneurship, innovation, and business development, focusing on the early stages of venture creation – from identifying problems, conducting market research, and defining customer needs, to developing a solution, unique value proposition, and initial business model. It provides practical tools and industry-proven methodologies. 	Learning Outcomes: By the end of the course, the students will be able to: 1.	Identify problems, opportunities, and needs in various markets. 2.	Define target audiences and conduct initial market research. 3.	Develop a solution and articulate a unique value proposition for the customer. 4.	Build an initial business model using industry-standard methodologies.
